title: a TCP read interrupted by a timeout or a cancelled task does not lose the reply that arrives later
purpose: Exercise a protocol boundary against a suite-owned loopback fixture.

provenance.expected_basis: The tcp-echo fixture answers `echo:` + the line only after a whole line arrives, so a read bounded to 0.1 s times out and a read in a cancelled task ends Cancelled; the reads await their native work directly since #264 wave A, so cancelling them cancels and settles that work and the next read receives the whole reply.
